---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or design change
title: "[Feature] Request here "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

Describe the problem you're trying to solve - not the solution yet. What's
the actual friction or limitation you're running into? This is the most
useful part of the issue; a clear problem statement matters more than a
fully-formed solution.

## Proposed Solution (optional)

If you have an idea of how this could work, describe it here. It's fine to
leave this rough - this is a starting point for discussion, not a spec.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why they didn't seem as good
a fit.

## Additional Context

Anything else relevant - how you're currently working around this, links
to similar features in other tools, etc.

---

**Note:** per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), pull requests are
not accepted unsolicited. If this feature gets alignment through
discussion here, a PR may be explicitly requested at that point - no need
to open one preemptively.
